name: Nishimura Yurika
source:
Daughter of the director of St. Eichi (St. H) Academy. She is a young lady from a good family. She exudes an aura of a young lady when dealing with her followers.

She feels that the protagonist has a distorted love for women.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/jyokyoshi/index.html]official site[/url]]
